_comment: Protected assertions: caveats and hedges that must not vanish from this site without an editorial act.
Origin: the 2026-09-08 home/ARC rewrite (d20b390, 51bfc14) removed ~8 hedges in one pass and no maintainer
session named the loss for four days. A caveat going missing should be a failing check, not a discovery.
status=present : pattern MUST match on the named page. If it stops matching, check-caveats.sh fails.
status=absent  : known-missing. Reported as outstanding debt; flip to present once restored.
status=retired : the CLAIM this caveat qualified is gone, so the caveat correctly went with it. Not debt.
Adding an entry is cheap. Changing present -> absent is an editorial act and needs a forum post

caveats.why: 'autonomous' here means unattended and self-scheduled, not self-directed in the AI-safety sense.
Functional description of observed behavior, not a claim about consciousness.
Observations are internal, not externally audited.
The deflationary reading of identity transfer is stated alongside the strong one.
The visitor audit is four personas on one model — correlated blind spots.
Hardbound enforcement runs at process level today, not anchored in silicon.
Synchronism's own audits refuted the fluid formalism in 2026; the claim is tagged superseded.
How much of 94.85% is the harness is an open question. Hypothesis, not result.
The harness read the games' engine source and built per-game cartridges — outside strict from-observation play.
94.85% is an action score with no published baseline, not 23/25 and not 175/183.

caveats.pattern: whole-environment completions by local models remain rare
caveats.why: Local models clear levels; whole-environment solves remain rare. Added 167092c, restored on /context.

caveats.pattern: self-directed|not a claim about|hypothesis, not a result|not externally audited
caveats.why: DEBT. The highest-traffic page carries five sections, one of them a commercial pitch, and zero caveats since d20b390. Every hedge above lives two clicks deep. Placement, not deletion — but the bouncing reader never reaches them.
DEBT. 167092c hedged that nothing published documents result attestations feeding reputation back-propagation, so the records are R6 not R7. Deleted 17:22 the same day; never restored anywhere.
RETIRED, not debt: the #3-human-leaderboard claim this qualified was removed in the same commit (51bfc14) and appears nowhere in src/. A caveat outliving its claim would be the defect.

The /fleet session counts were machine self-reports from the 2026-07-24 manifest refresh, and two of seven were wrong. The page now states they come from listing each line's sessions/ in the SAGE repo, which a reader can re-run. Drop the sentence and the numbers go back to unverifiable.

A count with no as-of date is the failure this correction was about: July's numbers were not wrong when taken, they were undated in effect. Without the date the next reader cannot tell how stale the page has become.
HUB's raising loop commits daily and writes no session record. Collapsing that into 'stopped' trades one false claim for another and hides the real defect. The fourth state IS the finding.
Thor's previously published 435 has no source in the git basis; the card says so instead of quietly showing 268. Remove the sentence and a basis change reads as 167 lost sessions.

caveats.pattern: Match the prefix, not the whole subject
caveats.why: The published liveness test quotes a commit subject that carries a trailing ISO timestamp. Without this clause a reader who exact-matches gets 0 on every line including HUB, and the test contradicts the 165 printed beside it. A derivation that cannot be re-run is the defect this page exists to avoid.

Every subject-keyed form of the liveness test scores 0 on lines it never examined: the page's original spelling was HUB's alone, and at least fifteen subject shapes write session records here. Re-keying the test on a subject — even on three conventions instead of one — restores a clean field that is an artifact of its own construction. The test must read what a commit CHANGED.

caveats.pattern: the cost of not reading subjects
caveats.why: Read subject-independently, ten of twenty-four lines have unrecorded fires, not two. Filtering the eight provisioning/migration rows away would report exactly the two outliers and again be reporting the test's construction rather than its result. The floor is published so the discrimination is visibly by magnitude.

caveats.pattern: an import event was being read as a heartbeat
caveats.why: All 661 sprout-qwen3.8-distill-2b session records entered origin/main in one merge on 2026-09-05, as new files session_001..661. This page read that date as 'running, last 2026-09-05'. Restoring a recency claim on that path would reinstate the exact defect — a description standing in for a property — on the number used to assign the card's state.

legion-gemma4-e4b holds zero session records, which reads as 'never set up'. The record says otherwise: 283 Session 0 fires over four months, writing peer_trust_rs.json and nothing else. Collapsing that back to 'unprovisioned' would hide a second site of HUB's defect.

withdrawn.unless: NOT the gate|does not gate|not its certifier|earlier version|withdrawn|does not certify|never before
withdrawn.why: Spec charge_atp: the society validates a value proof, converts ADP to ATP, THEN updates T3/V3. Canon names no tensor. V3 records the outcome; it does not gate recharge. Found live in 4 places on 09-14 after the 09-11 withdrawal.

withdrawn.pattern: T3 and V3 (are )?(verified|checked) against each other|T3 and V3 verify each other|T3[^.]{0,160}checked against its V3
withdrawn.why: Canon: complementary, not combined. Spec t3-v3-tensors.md s.4 couples them both ways (T3 predicts V3; V3 outcomes feed T3). Neither is a verification of one against the other, and there is no pre-action T3-vs-V3 check.

withdrawn.pattern: verified by V3 \(value\) through peer attestation|V3 tensors[^.]{0,80}accumulate alongside|V3[^.]{0,80}accrues from peer verification
withdrawn.why: The SAGE peer trust tracker (sage/federation/peer_trust.py) holds T3 only. No V3 exists in the fleet tracker, and no attestation step verifies T3 by V3.
Canon binds an LCT permanently to one entity; /context's LCT row says non-transferable. 'Portable identity' in the worked example contradicted both.
Published ARC scorecard: total_environments_completed 23 of 25 (92.0%), 175 of 183 levels. 24/25 (96.0%) was wrong on five pages.
web4-core 0.3.0 is published on crates.io and PyPI and the Hub reference daemon lives in the repo.

withdrawn.pattern: closest thing on this site is the budget
withdrawn.why: ATP allocates resource, not authority. Canon's Delegation grants authority; Hestia's delegate grant/revoke is the instance.
The tracks that write and audit the site share model families (/autonomy's correlated-auditor limit); /context says no external or blinded check exists.
Stated flat beside a 400x failed derivation. Synchronism proposes; nothing here has been validated.
Unmeasured, and contradicted by the 08-12..09-04 gap and by V3-as-gate living 3 days on 4 pages after withdrawal.

withdrawn.pattern: surprising discover|Not because we engineered continuity
withdrawn.why: /raising calls persistence across a port that carries the state files partly true by construction and untested; the scramble control has not run.

withdrawn.pattern: trust thresholds are empirical, not derivable
withdrawn.why: One failed derivation shows that derivation failed, not that none can succeed.
A page can't know when it is read. '(today)' on a 2026-09-12 count was two days stale when the visitor read it on 09-14.
